title: Threading Foundations
description: Start here if threads are new to you. Learn what a thread is, how to start one, and how the thread pool lends you workers so you don't have to create your own.

title: Tasks & Async/Await
description: The modern way to write asynchronous code in C#. Learn what a Task really is, what the compiler does with async/await, and how to run many things at once without losing your mind.

title: Synchronization Primitives
description: When threads share data, things break in sneaky ways. Learn lock, Semaphore, SemaphoreSlim and friends — the tools that keep threads from stepping on each other.

title: Concurrent Collections & Parallelism
description: Ready-made thread-safe collections, Parallel loops, PLINQ, Channels and TPL Dataflow — the heavy machinery for doing lots of work fast and safely.

title: Real-World Scenarios & Interview Prep
description: Put it all together: producer-consumer queues, rate limiters, caching stampedes, deadlock hunting, and the exact questions interviewers love to ask.
